description: Procurement slice by NAICS code. One NAICS slice of the Ni Biashara procurement shelf: active opportunities and recent awards for that code in one call. SAM summary records carry no NAICS, so v1 slices are award-led and say so in the payload. $0.1 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

limit.description: max records to return (optional, default 25, max 60)

name: get_procurement_by_naics
title: Procurement slice by NAICS code
